🧠 NLP Benchmark Suite
	


	
		
		Five core NLP tasks. One clean dataset. Zero setup headaches.
	








	
		
	
	
		📌 Dataset Description
	

NLP Benchmark Suite is a multi-task dataset covering the five most fundamental and widely-used NLP tasks in a single, consistent, and easy-to-load format.
Whether you are a student taking your first steps in NLP, a researcher running quick baseline experiments, or an engineer evaluating a production pipeline — this dataset is built for you.
